title: Resort Lodging Folio Charge Schedule: Resort, Housekeeping, Dogs and Parking
content:
Four charges are published against each Resort Lodging unit type for what a stay uses beyond the room itself.

The nightly resort charge in USD covers the shuttle, the fitness centre and the pools. The housekeeping charge is a one-off charge in USD raised on departure. Dogs are taken only in the unit types marked as taking them, and where they are taken a nightly charge in USD applies for a dog staying in the unit. Parking is published as a number of spaces included with the unit, together with a nightly charge in USD for each parking space beyond those included.

| Unit type | Nightly resort charge (USD) | Housekeeping charge (USD) | Dogs taken | Dog nightly charge (USD) | Parking spaces included | Parking nightly charge (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Base Village Inn Room | 18.00 | 0 | no | 0 | 0 | 28.00 |
| Slopeside Studio | 24.00 | 85.00 | yes | 45.00 | 1 | 28.00 |
| Slopeside One-Bedroom Residence | 32.00 | 135.00 | yes | 45.00 | 1 | 32.00 |
| Slopeside Two-Bedroom Residence | 38.00 | 195.00 | yes | 55.00 | 2 | 32.00 |
| Mountain Lodge Suite | 44.00 | 165.00 | no | 0 | 1 | 38.00 |
| Summit Penthouse Residence | 65.00 | 395.00 | no | 0 | 2 | 45.00 |
| Private Mountain Chalet | 95.00 | 750.00 | yes | 95.00 | 4 | 45.00 |

### Points of judgement on the figures

A housekeeping charge of 0 is published for the Base Village Inn Room, which is the only unit type carrying none. A dog nightly charge of 0 stands against every unit type that does not take dogs, and the three that do take them publish charges of 45.00, 55.00 and 95.00 USD. The parking spaces included and the parking nightly charge are separate figures: the Mountain Lodge Suite includes 1 space and publishes 38.00 USD a night, while the Private Mountain Chalet includes 4 spaces and publishes 45.00 USD a night.
